doc:
Delaborator for `LinearIndependent` that suggests pretty printing with type hints
in case the family of vectors is over a `Set`.

Type hints look like `LinearIndependent fun (v : ↑s) => ↑v` or `LinearIndependent (ι := ↑s) f`,
depending on whether the family is a lambda expression or not.

doc:

by the elements of `s` are linearly independent over `R`.

linearly independent family.

  [inst_2 : Module R M], LinearIndependent R v → ∀ (f : ι' → ι), Function.Injective f → LinearIndependent R (v ∘ f)

  LinearIndependent R v ↔
    ∀ (l₁ l₂ : ι →₀ R), (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l₁ = (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l₂ → l₁ = l₂

linearly independent.

doc:
If `f` is a linear map injective on the span of the range of `v`, then the family `f ∘ v`
is linearly independent if and only if the family `v` is linearly independent.
See `LinearMap.linearIndependent_iff_of_disjoint` for the version with `Set.InjOn` replaced
by `Disjoint` when working over a ring.

  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid M'] [inst_3 : Module R M] [inst_4 : Module R M'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M'),
  Set.InjOn ⇑f ↑(Submodule.span R (Set.range v)) → (LinearIndependent R (⇑f ∘ v) ↔ LinearIndependent R v)

∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {s : Set ι} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]

      ∀ g ∈ Finsupp.supported R R s, (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) f = (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) g → f = g

doc:
An indexed set of vectors is linearly dependent iff there are two distinct
`Finsupp.LinearCombination`s of the vectors with the same value.
statement:
∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {s : Set ι} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M],
  ¬LinearIndepOn R v s ↔
    ∃ f g,
      f ∈ Finsupp.supported R R s ∧
        g ∈ Finsupp.supported R R s ∧ (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) f = (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) g ∧ f ≠ g

doc: A version of `linearDepOn_iff'ₛ` with `Finsupp.linearCombination` unfolded.
statement:
∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {s : Set ι} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M],
  ¬LinearIndepOn R v s ↔
    ∃ f g,
      f ∈ Finsupp.supported R R s ∧
        g ∈ Finsupp.supported R R s ∧ ∑ i ∈ f.support, f i • v i = ∑ i ∈ g.support, g i • v i ∧ f ≠ g

doc: Canonical isomorphism between linear combinations and the span of linearly independent vectors.
statement:
{ι : Type u'} →
  {R : Type u_2} →
    {M : Type u_4} →
      {v : ι → M} →
        [inst : Semiring R] →
          [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] →
            [inst_2 : Module R M] → LinearIndependent R v → (ι →₀ R) ≃ₗ[R] ↥(Submodule.span R (Set.range v))

∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (hv : LinearIndependent R v) (a : ↥(Submodule.span R (Set.range v))),
  hv.linearCombinationEquiv.symm a =
    ((LinearEquiv.ofInjective (LinearMap.codRestrict (Submodule.span R (Set.range v)) (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) ⋯)
                ⋯).toEquiv.trans
          (LinearEquiv.ofTop
              (LinearMap.codRestrict (Submodule.span R (Set.range v)) (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) ⋯).range
              ⋯).toEquiv).invFun
      a

∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (hv : LinearIndependent R v) (x : ι →₀ R),
  ↑(hv.linearCombinationEquiv x) = (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) x

doc:
Linear combination representing a vector in the span of linearly independent vectors.

Given a family of linearly independent vectors, we can represent any vector in their span as
a linear combination of these vectors. These are provided by this linear map.
It is simply one direction of `LinearIndependent.linearCombinationEquiv`.
statement:
{ι : Type u'} →
  {R : Type u_2} →
    {M : Type u_4} →
      {v : ι → M} →
        [inst : Semiring R] →
          [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] →
            [inst_2 : Module R M] → LinearIndependent R v → ↥(Submodule.span R (Set.range v)) →ₗ[R] ι →₀ R

∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (hv : LinearIndependent R v) (x : ↥(Submodule.span R (Set.range v))),
  (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) (hv.repr x) = ↑x

∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (hv : LinearIndependent R v),
  Finsupp.linearCombination R v ∘ₗ hv.repr = (Submodule.span R (Set.range v)).subtype

∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (hv : LinearIndependent R v), hv.repr.ker = ⊥

∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (hv : LinearIndependent R v), hv.repr.range = ⊤

∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (hv : LinearIndependent R v) {l : ι →₀ R} {x : ↥(Submodule.span R (Set.range v))},
  (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l = ↑x → hv.repr x = l

∀ {ι : Type u'} {R : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} {v : ι → M} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (hv : LinearIndependent R v) (i : ι) (x : ↥(Submodule.span R (Set.range v))),
